<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Section 1-Registrants' Business and Operations</span></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Item 1.01- Entry into Material Definitive Agreement</span></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">In December 2025, TX Rail Products, Inc (&#8220;the company&#8221;) entered into a private placement transaction whereby it will sell to a single institutional investor six million shares (6,000,000) of the Company&#8217;s no par value Common Stock at a purchase price of $0.30 per share, for a total purchase price of $1,800,000. As part of the transaction, the investor also has the right to purchase 4 million shares (4,000,000) of the no par common stock at a price of $0.50 per share for a period of 36 months from the effective date. Both the initial investment and the warrant exercise price represent a premium to the current market price of $0.2450 per share as of the close of trading on December 23, 2025.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The investor agrees that the Company shall retain voting control over the shares of Common Stock purchased under this transaction, provided that the investor holds at least 1% of the Company&#8217;s outstanding Common Stock.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The shares of Common Stock purchased under this agreement shall be restricted securities and may not be sold, transferred or otherwise disposed of except in compliance with SEC Rule 144, which requires, among other conditions, a minimum holding period of one (1) year after issuance.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The closing date of the stock purchase transaction shall take place on a mutually agreed date upon satisfaction of all closing conditions, but no later than 30 days after the Effective date of December 23, 2025.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

			<td valign="top" style="width: 12%; ">

			</td>
		</tr>
